skills.name: airflow-pipeline-doctor
skills.description: Identifies broken Airflow pipelines by scanning DAG run failures, surfacing failed task instances, and retrieving logs to explain the root cause. Requires the astro-airflow-mcp MCP server to be connected.

skills.name: slack-bot-setup
skills.description: Set up, configure, and use the Slack MCP server for agent communication — posting, threading, file uploads, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval gates. Use when an agent needs to talk to Slack, or when standing up a new Slack bot for a workspace or client (the QBiz bot is the reference template). Requires the slack MCP server.
